data.content:
One dispute was sent: UE-tf06f, for $31.20. The owner skipped the other four drafted disputes, so I didn't retry them.

| Case | Amount | Win probability | Evidence | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| UE-tf06f | $31.20 | 90% (strong) | The ticket doesn't list the claimed Butter Chicken. The order was ready at 18:47 and picked up at 18:50. | **Sent** |
| UE-tf07g | $26.80 | 65% | The ticket lists the item. The order was picked up 6 minutes after it was ready. | Drafted, owner skipped |
| UE-tf04d | $18.25 | 77% | The ticket lists the item. The order was picked up 3 minutes after it was ready. | Drafted, owner skipped |
| UE-tf02b | $21.50 | 65% | The ticket lists the item. The order was picked up 4 minutes after it was ready. | Drafted, owner skipped |
| UE-tf03c | $15.00 | 77% | The ticket lists the item. The order was picked up 3 minutes after it was ready. | Drafted, owner skipped |

- **Moderate cases:** A ticket listing the item shows it was ordered and prepared, not that it was packed. Those cases rest on the ticket and the handoff timing.
- **Repeat claims:** The same customer account made 3 claims this period in both UE-tf03c and UE-tf04d. I kept that count out of the drafts so they don't comment on the customer.
- **Weak case:** UE-tf01a ($52.00, the largest deduction) is weak at 30% because there is no order ticket on file. **Action for you:** take a photo of the ticket for UE-tf01a, and I'll re-run the evidence checks and draft the dispute.
- **Not worked:**
  - UE-tf05e ($12.75, 55%) fell outside the top 5.
  - UE-tf08h, UE-tf09i and UE-tf00z were recommended skips. UE-tf00z is $0 and past its deadline.
- **Lessons:** None applied. My memory only holds DoorDash history, and recall found no resolved Uber Eats cases that match.
- **Next deadline:** 2026-12-12, 28 days away. That is when the skipped and weak cases expire unless you revisit them.

I saved the case notes to `/plan.md`. When you hear back on UE-tf06f, tell me and I'll record the outcome.
